target: The compressor wall thickness is 45 mm after the corrosion allowance is added, and the margin sits in the allowance rather than in the pressure term. The same design pressure basis runs through the absorber and the interconnecting line, and the discharge of the lean solvent pump sets the pressure the line and its flanges are checked against. For the gasketed joints the choice lies between the two candidate materials, and it is made on temperature limit alone. The higher-rated material is preferred. Its limit clears the highest temperature the joint can reach in service, while the lower-rated material leaves the joint sound only for as long as the temperature stays below a level that normal operation can approach during a throughput excursion. Pressure drop is not the deciding quantity at the joint, since $\Delta P$ across a flange pair is a small part of the line total, and the gasket choice does not touch NPSH at the lean solvent pump.
